annotations.title: Employer cost of a salary in Greece

description: What a salary in Greece costs the employer (employer social contributions itemised), or the reverse: the gross salary a total budget allows. Give gross_annual or budget_annual.

age.description: Age; changes the result here (young-worker reliefs, senior slabs, surcharges). Default 35.

budget_annual.description: Total yearly employer budget in EUR, to find the gross salary it allows

five_c.description: Article 5C relocation incentive. 50% of employment income exempt for 7 years after moving tax residence to Greece. Default false.
